lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Waking up to the morning haze
Lost in the glow of the golden days
I didn't know what I was looking for
Until you walked right through my door
[chorus]
Oh, it's a love that feels so new
Everything I do leads back to you
Like a rhythm in the midnight air
Love is everywhere, love is everywhere
[verse]
Tracing lines on your open palm
You're the center of my sudden calm
We don't need a reason or a plan
Just the touch of your steady hand
[chorus]
Oh, it's a love that feels so new
Everything I do leads back to you
Like a rhythm in the midnight air
Love is everywhere, love is everywhere
[bridge]
It's the promise in the way we speak
It's the safety that I finally seek
No more shadows hiding in the night
Just the fire that we keep alight
[chorus]
Oh, it's a love that feels so new
Everything I do leads back to you
Like a rhythm in the midnight air
Love is everywhere, love is everywhere
[outro]
